metadata.subject_title: Chin Lang & Literature & Chin Lang Education

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Immersion Experience - Putonghua
courses.description: The course is designed to provide students with opportunities to study and use Putonghua in a first language context while engaging themselves with the Putonghua culture, thus resulting in gains in language, professional and personal development. The course will be conducted in the format of a study programme to be conducted overseas. The course will include components such as language enhancement, cultural orientation and school experience or the equivalent.
courses.learning_outcomes:
●通過備考普通話水平測試語言課程，提高普通話語言能力，包括聽、說、讀等等。
●通過在地生活及文化體驗，提高日常會話及普通話交際能力。
●通過中、小學語言教學觀摩，了解不同教學背景下的語文教學模式、課程設計、教學法應用以及教學實施情況。拓寬視野，學習從不同角度去思考語文教學的形式、概念及組織。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Elementary Putonghua
courses.description: The course aims at helping students develop the basic listening and speaking skills of Putonghua. Through the study of the phonetic transcription (Hanyu Pinyin), the students can further master the pronunciation of Putonghua and be able to apply the Pinyin system to correct any wrong pronunciation.
courses.enrollment_requirement: Not for students who have taken LEDC2520
courses.learning_outcomes:
本科目以普通話基礎語音知識和語言表達為本，通過課堂教學和實踐掌握相應的交際會話、口頭表述及朗讀能力。具體包括：
●掌握漢語拼音方案， 具有拼音的聽辨、拼寫及譯寫能力。
●掌握粵語與普通話之間在詞彙、語音、語法及表達習慣上的差異。
●能以普通話進行日常會話和交際溝通。
●能流利地以普通話完成表述、說明及朗讀等任務。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Language, Thought and Writing
courses.description: This course aims at developing the students’ writing ability by deepening their understanding of cognitive processes in writing, and raising their awareness in monitoring/revising their own writing. These are achieved and supported by both lectures on related theories and writing/revising exercises. This course also introduces common writing difficulties of secondary/primary students and effective teaching strategies, so as to develop the students’ understanding of the principles and strategies of writing instruction.
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能：
1. 認識寫作的思維過程及其與語言運用的關係；
2. 掌握修訂文章的方法；
3. 掌握設計寫作課程和活動的原則；
4. 掌握寫作教學策略及掌握評估寫作的方法。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Methods of Chinese Language Teaching I
courses.description: This course aims at helping learners master the basic teaching skills and develop the ability of instructional design in Chinese language teaching. The following topics will be discussed in the course: the characteristics, the objectives, the contents and the principles of teaching Chinese. The course also covers the teaching of listening, speaking, reading and writing, the teaching of basic language knowledge and the design of instructional task in the Target-Oriented Curriculum.
courses.learning_outcomes:
- 學生能掌握中國語文的學科性質
- 學生能掌握中小學中國語文科的教學特色
- 學生能掌握中國語文的教學目標、內容
- 學生能掌握培養中國語文能力的基本原理
- 學生能掌握白話作品教學的基本原理及方法
- 學生能掌握語文基礎知識教學的基本原理及方法
- 學生能掌握各類文體教學的基本原理及方法

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Advanced Putonghua
courses.description: The course aims at strengthening students' ability in listening, reading aloud, and speaking in Putonghua. Part of the contents of the Putonghua Shuiping Ceshi (PSC) will also be covered so that students can have a better understanding of the requirements and techniques, and be well prepared for the examination.
courses.learning_outcomes:
CLED進階普通話的教學目標是繼續加強和鞏固普通話語言知識，學習和提高普通話表達和溝通技巧，提高普通話語用的準確性，兼顧聽、說、讀等各個方面的練習。本課程將繼續通過課堂練習和實踐來幫助學生提高相應的交際會話、口頭表述及朗讀能力，並兼顧以下各方面的學習：
●完成拼音系統的學習——溫故而知新。
●關注粵語與普通話之間在詞彙、語音、語法及表達習慣上的差異，關注普通話的多音字。
●結合相關話題進行口頭表達、朗讀、聆聽及演講的練習，提高普通話語言表達能力。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Methods of Chinese Language Teaching II
courses.description: This course aims at improving students' knowledge and understanding of language teaching theories, classroom teaching, language curriculum design, teaching strategies and evaluation. It also focuses on: 1) the teaching of appreciation in Chinese literature; 2) the teaching of classical works in Chinese; 3) the implementation of moral education through language teaching; 4) the guidance and supervision of extensive reading; 5) evaluation and assessment of Chinese language proficiency; and 6) the production of teaching aids and the preparation of lesson plans and teaching plans.
courses.learning_outcomes:
- 學生能掌握中國文學作品賞析教學的基本原則及方法
- 學生能掌握文言作品教學的基本原則及方法
- 學生能掌握文化、品德情意教育在中文教學中實踐的原則及方法
- 學生能掌握指導學生培養中國語文科自學能力的基本原則及方法
- 學生能掌握中國語文能力評鑑、測量的基本原則及方法
- 學生能掌握中國語文科教案、教學計劃的編製原則及方法

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Materials and Curriculum Design in Chinese Teaching
courses.description: This course aims to enhance students’ professional competence of Chinese language teaching through mastering and applying the theories, principles, and methods of curriculum and teaching materials design in designing and adapting school-based Chinese language curriculum and teaching materials. Topics covered include: 1) basic theories of curriculum design; 2) the development of Hong Kong Chinese language curriculum; 3) school-based language curriculum design and adjustment; 4) nature of different types of Chinese language teaching materials and 5) selection and design of different types of Chinese language teaching materials.
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科後，學員應能：

1. 了解語文課程的本質與理論；

2. 了解不同時期香港中國語文的課程特點；

3. 掌握校本單元課程的理念及原則；

4. 掌握語文科教材編選與設計的原則及方法；及

5. 應用本科所學設計出具質素的校本單元及教材。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Curriculum and Instructional Design for Using Putonghua as a Medium in Chinese Language Teaching
courses.description: This course provides participants with an overview of the curriculum design, instructional approaches and development of PMI in Hong Kong from the perspective of language teaching theories and curriculum and instruction theories. Topics covered include: (1) background and development of PMI in Hong Kong; (2) theoretical foundation of curriculum and instructional design of PMI; (3) implementation of classroom teaching of PMI; (4) analysis of PMI school-based curriculum and instruction and; (5) difficulties in and strategies for developing PMI curriculum.
courses.learning_outcomes:
●了解普教中教學模式的發展及影響因素。

●掌握設計和實施普教中課堂教學活動的理論和教學策略。

●掌握普教中校本課程的設計、實施及評核原則。

●了解普教中存在的教學困難並總結出有效的解決方法和策略。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Classroom Research in Chinese Language Teaching

meetings.instructor:
Dr. CHEUNG Yin Chu, 
Dr. KOU Zhihui, 
Dr. NG Mau Yuen Eric, 
Professor LAU Kit Ling, 
Professor PENG Yue

courses.description: This course provides an introduction to educational research to equip students with the skills of doing research on Chinese language teaching and learning. It aims to facilitate students’ professional development through enhancing their understanding and reflection on the complex factors of teaching and learning Chinese language. Major research designs and methods in language teaching are covered in the course. Students have to develop a research proposal for conducting a small-scale of classroom research in Chinese language teaching when they take CLED4730 in Year 5.
courses.component:
Discussion
Field Studies/Field-trip
Lecture
Interactive Tutorial
courses.learning_outcomes:
預期學習成果：
完成本科的學習後，學員應具備以下的知識、能力或態度：
1. 對中國語文教學研究有清晰的概念；
2. 了解不同類型教育研究設計的特點，並反思不同設計範式的優點和限制；
3. 掌握進行教育研究的各種方法，並反思不同研究方法的優點和限制；
4. 對進行中文教學研究抱持正面的態度，了解教學研究對促進教師專業成長的重要性；
5. 應用所學的研究設計和方法，撰寫初步的研究建議書。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Research Report in Chinese Language Teaching

meetings.instructor:
Dr. NG Mau Yuen Eric, 
Professor LAU Kit Ling, 
Professor PENG Yue

courses.description: This course is an extended course of CLED4720. Instructors will guide students to conduct a small-scale of classroom research in Chinese language teaching. Students have to collect data during their Teaching Supervision and analyze data afterward. It aims to facilitate students’ professional development through enhancing their understanding and reflection on their personal teaching ability, students’ language learning needs, and other factors affecting teaching and learning Chinese language.
courses.component:
Field Studies/Field-trip
Lecture
Project
Interactive Tutorial
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科的學習後，學員應具備以下的知識、能力或態度：
1. 掌握及應用各種教育研究的方法進行中國語文教學相關的探究；
2. 掌握收集和分析研究資料的原則和方法；
3. 針對研究結果，對個人的教學能力、學生語文學習的需要以及其他影響語文教學的因素作出認真的反思；
4. 結合語文教學理論、實踐經驗以及研究結果，撰寫出完整的研究報告；
5. 對進行中文教學研究抱持正面的態度，並培養出有系統收集資料以了解、反思和改善教學的習慣，通過教學研究促進專業成長。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Chinese Language Teaching Assessment
courses.description: This course introduces the concepts, principles, and methods of language assessment. It aims to enhance students' ability in designing and implementing different assessment tools to provide feedback for teaching and learning. This course also provides an overview of the development of Chinese language assessment in Hong Kong, and discuss current issues related to Chinese language assessment.
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科的學習後，學員應：
- 了解語文評估的概念、原則和方式；
- 了解新課程的評估要求；
- 掌握不同評估工具的設計和施行，以回饋學與教。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Current Issues in Chinese Language Education
courses.description: This course is designed to enrich students' understanding of current trends, including recent policy initiatives, curriculum developments or research, in Chinese language education. The background and implications of these issues on the teaching and learning of Chinese will be analysed. Ways to address these issues at the school and classroom levels will be explored. It aims to develop students' professional ability to apply the new educational theories and concepts in their daily Chinese language teaching under the changing curriculum.
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成課程後，學員將能夠：
1. 深入認識相關議題所涉學理及脈絡環境；
2. 分析相關議題在教學環境中呈現之實況；
3. 應用本科所學設計和實施教學以回應中文教育課程最新發展。
（具體學習成果視研習課題由任課教師自行釐訂）
